Question: The block diagram of a closed-loop control system is shown in the figure. \( R(s) \), \( Y(s) \), and \( D(s) \) are the Laplace transforms of the time-domain signals \( r(t) \), \( y(t) \), and \( d(t) \), respectively. Assuming the reference input \( r(t) = 0 \) for all \( t \), the steady-state error \( e(\infty) \), due to a unit step disturbance \( d(t) \), is _______ (rounded off to one decimal places).

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, R(s) enters the first summing point from the left, and the left input is labeled with a positive sign; the output Y(s) returns to the lower end of this summing point through the lower feedback line, and is labeled with a negative sign. Therefore the output of the first summing point is E(s)=R(s)-Y(s). This signal then passes through the gain block 10. After that it enters the second summing point; in the figure the disturbance D(s) enters the second summing point from above and is labeled with a positive sign, and the signal from gain 10 is also added as a positive input. The output of the second summing point enters the transfer function block 1/[s(s+10)], whose output is Y(s). Reasoning: From the figure one can write E(s)=R(s)-Y(s). The problem states r(t)=0, so R(s)=0, therefore E(s)=-Y(s). The signal entering the controlled object 1/[s(s+10)] is 10E(s)+D(s), so Y(s)=(1/[s(s+10)])(10E(s)+D(s)). Substituting E(s)=-Y(s), obtain Y(s)=(1/[s(s+10)])(-10Y(s)+D(s)). Rearranging: Y(s)[s(s+10)+10]=D(s), therefore Y(s)/D(s)=1/(s^2+10s+10). The unit step disturbance d(t) corresponds to D(s)=1/s, so Y(s)=1/[s(s^2+10s+10)]. Using the final value theorem, y(∞)=lim_{s->0} sY(s)=1/(0+0+10)=0.1. Since e(t)=r(t)-y(t), and r(t)=0, e(∞)=-y(∞)=-0.1.

method.method_draft: From the diagram write E(s)=R(s)-Y(s). With R(s)=0, E(s)=-Y(s). The signal entering the plant is 10E(s)+D(s), so Y(s)= [1/(s(s+10))][10E(s)+D(s)]. Substitute E(s)=-Y(s) to obtain Y(s)[1+10/(s(s+10))]=D(s)/(s(s+10)), hence Y(s)/D(s)=1/(s^2+10s+10). For a unit step D(s)=1/s, use the final value theorem: y(infinity)=lim_{s->0} sY(s)=lim_{s->0} 1/(s^2+10s+10)=0.1. Since e(t)=r(t)-y(t) and r(t)=0, e(infinity)=-0.1.

推理：由图可写 E(s)=R(s)-Y(s)。题设 r(t)=0，所以 R(s)=0，因此 E(s)=-Y(s)。进入被控对象 1/[s(s+10)] 的信号为 10E(s)+D(s)，所以 Y(s)=(1/[s(s+10)])(10E(s)+D(s))。代入 E(s)=-Y(s)，得 Y(s)=(1/[s(s+10)])(-10Y(s)+D(s))。整理：Y(s)[s(s+10)+10]=D(s)，因此 Y(s)/D(s)=1/(s^2+10s+10)。单位阶跃扰动 d(t) 对应 D(s)=1/s，所以 Y(s)=1/[s(s^2+10s+10)]。用终值定理，y(∞)=lim_{s->0} sY(s)=1/(0+0+10)=0.1。由于 e(t)=r(t)-y(t)，且 r(t)=0，所以 e(∞)=-y(∞)=-0.1。
